note: Every critical event: one sound AND one visual, and a second signal when it is colour-coded. Checked by: python3 tools/ui_check.py signals. Values are proposals from the GDD draft (6 Nov 2026); a design change edits the row, never deletes it. Owners: Asset Specialist makes the sound/visual, Art Director passes the grayscale capture, UI and UX keeps this file. sound_id names a row in pipeline/audio/sound-list.csv. A blank sound_id fails unless the sound is 'none'. Two events share a sound_id only with a shared_ok reason (key events need distinct sounds). sound_status 'requested' = asked of the audio lane: ci prints PENDING until the row exists, and ci --release fails on it. Drop the flag once the row lands. progress-motif needs a second signal that is not colour even if its colour cell is blank.

events.second_signal: clock hands spin and owl leans back (pose change)
events.visual: amber clock flash on the owl chest, max 3 per second
wing pose plus flow lines filling the gust rectangle before it is live

events.second_signal: straight bolt shape with clock-gear head
curved trail and returning arrowhead shape, not the straight bolt
events.sound: lower swoop distinct from bolt launch
soft canvas thump, not the hurt sound
events.visual: catch flash on the front of the umbrella; the bolt vanishes with no hit-stop and no health change (GDD SH1.0 SURV-05, FLOW-33, 7A)

events.sound: rising mend chime after the catch
events.visual: umbrella wear steps back toward intact (+20 HP); never shown on a catch during the 2 s cooldown
flow lines always mark the safe wind zone boundary; they brighten while the player is inside (WIND-01)
hit-stop, sprite blink at most 3 per second, one health pip removed

events.sound: heartbeat or ticking layer under the music
events.visual: one health pip left, pip outline pulses
new tear appears on the canopy

events.second_signal: two visible holes and a bent rib
events.sound: fabric rip when entering the tier
events.shared_ok: entering tier 2 is the tear itself; the tier change and the tear are one moment, so one sound

events.second_signal: canopy in tatters with exposed ribs and flapping strips
events.sound: fabric rip plus strained creak loop
events.shared_ok: GDD SH1.0 ANIM-04: the living critical state is the low-health state, one sound; the clock HUD is the primary health display (SURV-05)

events.visual: owl pauses, background motif completes, projectiles fade
Survived card with one text line; waits for input

events.second_signal: the motif shape fills one more segment at 25, 50, 75 and 100% of the hour
events.sound: music adds a layer at 25% and 70%
events.visual: background motif changes shape as the hour runs out (concept is GDD section 12 open; the row stays whichever is picked)
clock hands jolt and the current wind-up stops
a new tear on the wing overlay; the next gust shows fewer flow lines
fail card with the failure cause in text and a retry prompt
